content.name: Countercharm
entries: You can use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. If you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw against an effect that applies the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} or {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to cause the save to be rerolled, and the new roll has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52}.
